# Range

> Read-only intelligence for tokenized-stock perpetuals on Bitget and trade.xyz: every reviewed pair priced in both directions against executable order-book depth, taker fees, slippage and funding, with the evidence behind every number. Range holds no keys and places no orders.

Public and keyless: REST at https://range.datatides.xyz/v1, an MCP server (Streamable HTTP) at https://range.datatides.xyz/mcp, and the OpenAPI document at https://range.datatides.xyz/openapi.json. Underlyings look like equity:NVDA; the reviewed stocks are AAPL, AMZN, COIN, GOOGL, HOOD, META, MSFT, MSTR, NVDA and TSLA. Venue ids include bitget and hyperliquid_hip3 (trade.xyz). Every response is an envelope with status (ok, partial or rejected), as_of, freshness, result, evidence, warnings and trace_id; numbers are decimal strings. All public callers share one budget: 600 calls a minute for scans, inspections, pair evaluations and the markets board, 60 for everything else; on HTTP 429 wait up to a minute. An empty scan is normal: most gaps do not clear their costs, and /v1/pairs says how close each pair is and why.

## Docs

- [Documentation site](https://range-2.gitbook.io/range-docs/): the pages below, rendered and searchable
- [Range for agents](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KAMEVETRICS/range/main/docs/agents/README.md): which call answers which question, names, limits
- [MCP server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KAMEVETRICS/range/main/docs/agents/mcp.md): connecting clients, the eight tools and their arguments
- [Recipes](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KAMEVETRICS/range/main/docs/agents/recipes.md): worked examples
- [API overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KAMEVETRICS/range/main/docs/api/README.md): base URLs, the envelope, errors and limits
- [Endpoints](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KAMEVETRICS/range/main/docs/api/endpoints.md): every operation with parameters and examples
- [Streaming](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KAMEVETRICS/range/main/docs/api/streaming.md): Server-Sent Events
- [How Range prices a trade](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KAMEVETRICS/range/main/docs/concepts/pricing.md): fills, costs, net edge and rejection reasons
- [Funding](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KAMEVETRICS/range/main/docs/concepts/funding.md): why headline rates mislead and what Range projects
- [Currentness and evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KAMEVETRICS/range/main/docs/concepts/currentness-and-evidence.md): expiry, replacement and checking a result
